form.label: Lab Security Overview
form.description: Windows event logs from the lab forwarders (index wineventlog), network-device syslog via Scribbler (index netdev) and the LAB / LAB NET alerts. Managed from MC01 tools\splunk-uf\ds\apps\lab_security.

search.query: | tstats count where index=wineventlog by host | fields host
| tstats dc(host) as hosts where (index=_internal OR index=wineventlog) earliest=-15m
| tstats count where index=wineventlog host="$host$"
index=wineventlog `lab_win(Security)` EventCode=4625 host="$host$" | stats count
index=_audit action=alert_fired ss_app IN ("lab_security", "DA-ESS-ContentUpdate") | stats count

panel.title: Forwarder status (anything silent for 15+ min is SILENT)

search.query: | tstats latest(_time) as last_seen where (index=_internal OR index=wineventlog) earliest=-7d by host | eval minutes_ago=round((now()-last_seen)/60, 0), status=if(minutes_ago>=15, "SILENT", "OK"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | table host status minutes_ago last_seen | sort - minutes_ago host

index=_audit action=alert_fired ss_app IN ("lab_security", "DA-ESS-ContentUpdate") | eval severity=case(severity=6,"critical",severity=5,"high",severity=4,"medium",severity=3,"low",true(),severity) | table _time ss_name severity | rename ss_name as alert | head 50

panel.title: Network devices (via Scribbler) - QUIET = nothing for 48 h, NEVER = not logging yet

search.query: | inputlookup netdev_assets | rename ip AS host, dvc_name AS device | join type=left host [| tstats count latest(_time) as last_seen where index=netdev sourcetype!=scribbler:bridge earliest=-7d by host] | eval hours_ago=round((now()-last_seen)/3600, 1), status=case(isnull(last_seen), "NEVER", hours_ago>=48, "QUIET", true(), "OK"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | fillnull value=0 count | table device host purdue_level dvc_role status hours_ago last_seen count | rename count AS events_7d | sort purdue_level device

index=netdev sourcetype=scribbler:bridge earliest=-15m | stats latest(_time) as last latest(status) as status latest(error) as error sum(fetched) as fetched_15m | eval minutes_ago=round((now()-last)/60, 1), status=case(isnull(last), "NO HEARTBEAT", minutes_ago>3, "STALE", true(), status) | table status minutes_ago fetched_15m error

index=_audit action=alert_fired ss_app=lab_security ss_name="LAB NET*" | eval severity=case(severity=6,"critical",severity=5,"high",severity=4,"medium",severity=3,"low",true(),severity) | table _time ss_name severity | rename ss_name as alert | head 30

| tstats count where index=netdev sourcetype!=scribbler:bridge by _time host span=10m | lookup netdev_assets ip AS host OUTPUT dvc_name AS device | eval device=coalesce(device, host) | timechart span=10m sum(count) by device limit=15
`lab_net_denies` | `lab_net_deny_fields` | timechart span=10m count by device
`lab_net_changes` | `lab_net_change_fields` | eval what=substr(what, 1, 160) | table _time device user via what | head 40

index=netdev sourcetype=scalance:syslog | eval device=coalesce(netdev_name, host) | stats count latest(_time) as last latest(msg) as latest_message by device event_class | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T") | sort device - count

`lab_net_denies` | `lab_net_deny_fields` | stats count dc(dest) as dests values(dest_port) as dest_ports by device src | eval dest_ports=mvjoin(mvindex(dest_ports, 0, 9), ",") | sort - count | head 20
| tstats prestats=t count where index=wineventlog host="$host$" by _time host span=10m | timechart span=10m count by host limit=12

panel.title: Failed logons by account and source

search.query: index=wineventlog `lab_win(Security)` EventCode=4625 host="$host$" | `lab_failed_logon_fields` | stats count latest(_time) as last values(reason) as reason by host user src | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T") | sort - count | head 25

index=wineventlog `lab_win(Security)` EventCode IN (4720,4722,4724,4725,4726,4728,4732,4740,4756) host="$host$" | `lab_account_change_fields` | eval change=case(EventCode=4720,"user created",EventCode=4722,"user enabled",EventCode=4724,"password reset",EventCode=4725,"user disabled",EventCode=4726,"user deleted",EventCode=4740,"locked out",true(),"added to group") | eval object=coalesce(if(change="added to group", member." -> ".group, null()), target_user) | table _time host change object actor | head 50

panel.title: Remote and interactive logons (RDP = type 10, console = type 2)

search.query: index=wineventlog `lab_win(Security)` EventCode=4624 host="$host$" | `lab_logon_fields` | search logon_type IN (2, 10) user!="*$" user!="DWM-*" user!="UMFD-*" | eval logon=if(logon_type=10, "RDP", "console") | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user logon src | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T") | sort - last | head 25

index=wineventlog ((`lab_win(System)` EventCode=7045) OR (`lab_win(Security)` EventCode=4697)) host="$host$" | `lab_service_fields` | stats count latest(_time) as last values(host) as hosts by service service_file | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T") | sort - last | head 25

panel.title: Events by log and event code

search.query: index=wineventlog host="$host$" | eval LogName=coalesce(LogName, Channel) | stats count dc(host) as hosts by LogName EventCode | sort - count | head 30
